name: Intercostal-nerve cryoneurolysis for postoperative analgesia research
description: Cryogenic nerve-conduction intervention research is distinct from oocyte vitrification and the in-vitro cancer-cell bath experiment.

sources.citation: Graves et al.2019,randomized Nuss-procedure clinical trial

reported_equipment: AtriCure cryosurgical system;thoracoscopy;exact historical probe model not established here

requirements.rationale: The procedure requires a nerve-contact cryoprobe; a cold tissue bath or freezing carrier is not equivalent.
The selected study reports-60 C cryoprobe operation; this is never mapped to console ambient or uniform tissue temperature.
The primary study performs the procedure under thoracoscopic visualization; a console alone does not establish this installed chain.

missing_information: This scientific equipment profile is not a clinical eligibility check or instructions for performing surgery.
The study predates the consulted cryoSPHERE IFU; the selected probe is a documented modern candidate,not falsely identified as the exact historical probe.
Typical probe temperature does not establish tissue temperature or a nerve's response;direct visualization remains UNKNOWN for the bare candidate configuration.
confirmation_note: Source-specific requirements reviewed by the catalog author on 2026-10-31. They describe the selected procedure, not a universal limit. Users must confirm them before a run; edits require confirmation again.
